packageRules.description: Our own image: compose.yaml must follow the moving :stable or :dev tag, so never pin it to a digest or bump it.
Manifests keep lower bounds only; uv.lock and package-lock.json carry the tested versions. Overrides the preset's devDependency pinning.
Merge minor, patch, digest and lock-file updates once the required checks pass. Majors wait for review.
A Python minor release (3.14 to 3.15) also moves requires-python and needs torch wheels for the new Python, so it gets its own PR and waits for approval on the Dependency Dashboard.
The torch family is also pinned in container/torch-cpu.txt and scripts/setup-profiles.json.
prBodyNotes: Run `uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/update_torch_pins.py` on this branch and commit the result. See CONTRIBUTING.md, Upgrading dependencies.

customManagers.description: The Node.js release CI installs with actions/setup-node.

prBodyNotes: If this moves torch, torchvision or torchaudio, the setup and container pin tests fail until `uv run --frozen --no-sync python scripts/update_torch_pins.py` is run on this branch and committed.
